summary: Prepare owner-wide coverage, verified purchase binding and separate per-business allowance policy, plus enrollment/release commands behind a transactional port. No live adapter, endpoint, catalog cutover or activation.
noAssistantImpact: No new assistant tool, model authority, merchant grant or runtime entitlement change. Prepared billing commands require the active paying owner and fresh business ownership; software-plan configuration/purchase stays form-only. Persistence, canonical provider/event reconciliation and domain integration remain required before these staged functions can authorize paid access.

evidence.result: 31 tests / 107 assertions pass with a minimal environment, dead DB sentinel and socket/fetch refusal. Covers authority, 1/3/10 business caps, per-business allowances, expiry/refund state, downgrade/legacy preservation, exact receipt/linked binding, duplicate purchase, retry and serialized in-memory port conflicts/rollback. Strict module/test types pass; no PostgreSQL/provider/native acceptance claimed.
